set.body: Plan: raise the graphics plot system from a solid 8/10 to a cleaner 9/10 by reducing hand-wired compiler repetition, making trained scales drive guides, turning layout into a real allocation contract, and making backend conformance reusable. Acceptance: internal typed aesthetic environment, explicit compiler phases, automatic guide derivation, plot layout solver, and reusable renderer conformance harness, all preserving the renderer-neutral Plot -> resolved IR -> Scene -> backend pipeline and verified on JVM and JS. Revised 2026-07-08 after code assessment: added two correctness gates that must land before the conformance harness so every future backend inherits correct semantics -- (1) explicit y-orientation policy (SVG currently renders plots vertically mirrored; bottom axes draw at the visual top) and (2) numeric length resolution at the render boundary (SVG currently emits calc()/percentage strings that are invalid SVG geometry and impossible for Canvas/Java2D/JavaFX). Semantic expansion (stats, coords, facets, positions, theme, DSL) stays in the target-10 follow-on planning gate.
